title: Convexity, the spectrum of free Laplacians and geometric consequences: a free KLS bound
summary: We establish a compactness theorem for the resolvent of free Laplacians. More precisely, let $X=(X_1,\ldots,X_n)$ be a self-adjoint tuple admitting Lipschitz conjugate variables in the sense of Dabrowski (2014). Under the non-commutative curvature--dimension condition $CD(c,\infty)$ with $c>0$, introduced in our previous work (2026), we prove that the free Laplacian $Δ:=\partial^*\bar\partial$ is proper, that is, has compact resolvent.
